disclosure_risk: none - contains no corpus text, excerpts, or learner text
scope: research-only evaluation DESIGN for WU-E; no partitions are created, no model is trained, no learner-facing output exists

score_linkage.source: TOOLS/exp.xls and TOOLS/exp.sav (raw SWECCL, read-only metadata inspection)
score_linkage.key: ID = WEXP#### exact match to corpus document ids

protected_block.duplicate_policy: duplicate-group members are never split across dev/eval
protected_block.development_use: requires explicit Research Evaluation approval; protected block is not development material by default

evaluation_objectives: design an evaluation of the WU-A/B/C research pipeline (student FeatureSnapshot, task matching, observed-descriptive comparison) against the human expository scores
define descriptive association metrics between observed-descriptive comparison output (estimated percentile, z_distance per feature) and rater scores
record leakage and admissibility constraints so any future execution stays research-only and protected

metrics_design.metric: descriptive association between per-feature observed-descriptive comparison output and Average_score
metrics_design.claim_limit: observed-descriptive association only; no causal claim, no diagnostic threshold, no proficiency/mastery/learning-gain interpretation

metrics_design.metric: coverage and availability accounting (feature/distribution availability across the block)

constraints: no final train/dev/test partitions are created by this design
duplicate-group members never split across any future dev/eval grouping
protected block is not used as development material without Research Evaluation approval
no proficiency/mastery/learning-gain vocabulary in any evaluation output
no LLM computation of corpus statistics (I5)
no raw corpus text, excerpts, or reconstructed wording in any evaluation artifact
no raw SWECCL path or handle leaves the CORPUS boundary (ADR-06)

fail_closed: learner-facing display of corpus content (D-08 gate)
external redistribution, public release, training use
raw corpus export or third-party access
